topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, outlining the course structure and key learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of differentiation and tissue organization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer emerges from disrupted genetic regulation and the loss of normal tissue differentiation and three-dimensional architecture.

topics.label: Pathology and routes of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how malignant tumors breach structural boundaries to invade local tissues and disseminate to distant organs.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and benign tumor risks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the multistep transition from precursor lesions to invasive malignancies alongside the clinical complications caused by benign tumors.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the standard conventions and notable exceptions used to classify and name neoplasms according to their tissue of origin and malignant potential.

topics.label: Mechanisms of tumor-induced morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical, physiological, and metabolic processes through which localized and disseminated cancers cause illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across humans and animal species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare patterns of cancer frequency across human tissues, companion animals, and diverse multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Principles and applications of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the rationale, histological methods, and clinical efficacy of population-level screening programs for early cancer detection.

topics.label: Conclusion and practical session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture's closing remarks and instructions for upcoming revision and practical sessions.
